policy: This is a historical metadata archive. It is not an active content registry and cannot establish a current action, source mapping, runtime behavior, scientific claim, or rendering state.
Retired rows are preserved exactly from the frozen candidate input. Reactivation requires current source-owner evidence; an ID or label resemblance alone is insufficient.

Composition-preserved rows remain active in the source trace registry because their explicit preserveIds mappings and compiler witness evidence establish current composed identities even though the raw-only checker cannot resolve them.
